svg.title: The Notice
svg.desc: A sunburst with no wall. Sixteen rays leave a light at the centre. The first carries a ring, and each ray after it carries one more bead than the last, up to fifteen, so the rays wind outward like a shell. At the end of every ray hangs a small sign of four places, each a bead or a ring, and no two signs are alike. Around the outside runs a rim of sixty-four of the same signs. A beam of light turns round the rim one sign a beat, and the ray that carries that sign lights and counts its beads. Read clockwise from the empty ray, with a bead as one and a ring as nothing, the rim's sixty-four signs are these hexadecimal digits: 7 6 d 4 5 4 8 4 9 5 6 7 4 8 e 1 4 a 7 3 0 6 e 7 e e c f b f e 6 9 1 b e 0 3 d b 9 a b 8 5 7 a e 2 8 5 b a b b 1 f 1 8 7 c 6 e 7.
